Question B-006-004-002.

Why the correct answer is right: Open-wire line has low loss and can tolerate high SWR with less heating when installed properly.

Per-choice notes:
- sourceIndex 0: "It can be operated at high SWR without excessive loss": Correct. Open-wire line has low loss and can tolerate high SWR with less heating when installed properly.
- sourceIndex 1: "It can be located near metal objects without problems": This describes a different installation property; open-wire advantage is its low loss when installed properly.
- sourceIndex 2: "It has low impedance, which facilitates matching to a transceiver": This describes a different installation property; open-wire advantage is its low loss when installed properly.
- sourceIndex 3: "It does not radiate RF energy, which could cause interference to nearby equipment": This describes a different installation property; open-wire advantage is its low loss when installed properly.
